title: LogConsole
description: This mod opens a console window when you launch Minecraft. It also allows you to interact with Minecraft itself, which can be very convenient.
body:
What the mod does, what it's for, and what can be added later. What it does: a separate log window (Windows, Swing) with duplicate Minecraft logs, command entry from the window, colorized output (ANSI and §), log filters, color and font settings.

Why it's useful: easy log viewing without cmd, macros via /import, quick actions (/press, /click, /look, /go, /slot, /atack, etc.) without manually editing files.

Limitations (stability): /go and part of /atack depend on server permissions; /press and clicks depend on window focus; a separate .exe editor is not included in this build.

Future ideas: a separate small Java launcher (.exe) just for the editor; syntax highlighting in the editor; macro key bindings; script profiles; integration with Mod Menu again (no API conflicts).

Libraries: no additional ones required - just JDK and what Fabric/Minecraft already supports (Gson, etc.).
